fact: The World Bank mission of 30 October to 30 November 2023 lists interoperability between birth and identification registers as a priority use case to be built on X-Road integrating DNRN and DNIC services, reports integrated birth and BI registration brigades in Inhambane and Zambezia since May 2023 (59,000 birth certificates, 42,800 IDs), and notes there is no coherent process to integrate DNIC and DNRN data.
title: Projecto de Governação e Economia Digitais (EDGE, P172350): Missão de Apoio à Implementação de 30 de Outubro a 30 de Novembro de 2023, Aide Memória
